The Noble Character of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) and Hadhrat Mu'aadh bin Jabal (RA)

Hadhrat Saalim says, "Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) never cursed a single slave save for one whom he then set free (as compensation)." Hadhrat Zuhri says that as he was about to curse a slave, Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) said, "O Allaah! May Your cur..." He then did not complete the word (curse) and said, "That is a word that I hate to mention."[^2]

The narration has already passed in the chapter entitled "The fervour that Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA) had to Spend in the Path of Allaah"[^3], in which Hadhrat Jaabir (RA) says, "Mu'aadh bin Jabal (RA) was amongst the most handsome of people, amongst those with the best character and the most open-handed."
Rasulullaah ﷺ's Tolerance with the Person who Criticised the Manner in which he Distributed the Booty of the Battle of Hunayn

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) reports, "After the Battle of Hunayn Rasulullaah ﷺ gave extra (booty) to some people. He gave Aqra bin Haabis (RA) and Uyaynah bin Hisn (RA) a hundred camels each and gave a lot to certain other people as well. Someone remarked, 'Allaah's pleasure was certainly not intended in this distribution.' I said, 'I am definitely going to report this to Rasulullaah ﷺ!' When I reported it to Rasulullaah ﷺ, he said, 'May Allaah shower His mercy on Moosa (AS). Greater abuse than this was hurled at him but he exercised patience.'"

Another narration states: "Someone said, 'By Allaah! There is no justice in this distribution and Allaah's pleasure was certainly not intended.'
